Corporate Core Megatower.brief: Three arms of near-black glass rising from the plaza, red light seams up the arm edges, a halo crown visible across the bay.

notes: From cities/vesper_bay/prompt.md. Old Town markets and temples: heritage signage weighted to Hanzi and Hangul. Neon Strand, the waterfront entertainment strip: more wear, denser ads, a pink, cyan, amber and violet neon palette. Corporate Core cleaner and quieter than its era; Highcrest (quiet residential heights) cleanest. The Stacks add capsule stacks to the brutalist megablocks. Owners: the four with most buildings in the build, brand colors invented to fit their names (no third-party brands). The megatower brief follows the prompt's three-armed tower. Era presets kept for everything else.
